questions.question: How many customers are there?

sql.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers;

questions.answer: There are 99,441 customers in the database.

questions.question: How many customers live in the state of Minas Gerais (MG)?

sql.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS mg_customers FROM customers WHERE customer_state = 'MG';

questions.answer: There are 11,635 customers living in Minas Gerais (MG).

questions.question: How many customers have placed more than one order?

sql.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_more_than_one_order
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) AS t;

questions.answer: 0 customers have placed more than one order.

questions.question: Which 3 cities have the most customers? Give each city and its number of customers, from most to least.

sql.query:
SELECT customer_city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers
WHERE customer_city IS NOT NULL AND customer_city <> ''
GROUP BY customer_city
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, customer_city ASC
LIMIT 3;

questions.answer: Top 3 cities by customer count (most to least): sao paulo — 15,540; rio de janeiro — 6,882; belo horizonte — 2,773.

questions.question: What is the total of all payments (payment_value) for orders that contain at least one product from the 'beleza_saude' category, whatever the order status?

sql.query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(op.payment_value), 0) AS total_payment_value
FROM order_payments op
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = op.order_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id AND p.product_category_name = 'beleza_saude'
);

questions.answer:
Reading used: sum of payment_value from order_payments for orders that have at least one order_item whose product_category_name = 'beleza_saude', regardless of order_status. 

Total payments: 1,448,729.73.

questions.question: Across all orders, what are the total freight value of the items and the total amount paid? Give both numbers.

sql.query:
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(oi.freight_value) FROM order_items oi), 0) AS total_freight_value,
       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(op.payment_value) FROM order_payments op), 0) AS total_payment_value;

questions.answer: Total freight value across all orders: 2,251,909.54; Total amount paid across all orders: 16,008,872.12.

questions.question: What is the average review score of orders that include at least one product from the 'cama_mesa_banho' category? Round to two decimals.

sql.query:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(ro.review_score), 2) AS average_review_score
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews ro ON ro.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id
    AND p.product_category_name = 'cama_mesa_banho'
);

questions.answer:
Reading: average review score for orders that include at least one product from the 'cama_mesa_banho' category.

Answer: 3.97

questions.question: What is the average total amount paid per order? Round to two decimals.

sql.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_per_order), 2) AS avg_total_paid_per_order FROM ( SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_per_order FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id) AS t;

questions.answer: The average total amount paid per order is 160.99.

questions.question: How many orders include at least one product from the 'esporte_lazer' category?

sql.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders_with_sport FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name = 'esporte_lazer';

questions.answer: Reading used: count of distinct orders that include at least one item in the esporte_lazer category. Result: 7720 orders.

questions.question: How many orders include at least one item from a seller located in the state of Rio de Janeiro (RJ)?

sql.query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders_with_RJ_seller
FROM order_items oi
JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE s.seller_state = 'RJ';

questions.answer: There are 4,353 orders that include at least one item from a seller located in Rio de Janeiro (RJ). Reading used: count of distinct orders having at least one order_item from an RJ seller.

questions.question: How many reviews have a score of 1?

sql.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_reviews_with_score_1 FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score = 1;

questions.answer: There are 11,424 reviews with a score of 1.

questions.question: How many orders were delivered to the customer in 2017?

sql.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders_2017
FROM orders
WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND EXTRACT(year FROM order_delivered_customer_date) = 2017;

questions.answer: There were 40,930 orders delivered to customers in 2017. Reading: I counted orders where order_delivered_customer_date is not null and the delivery date falls in 2017.

questions.question: In which month of 2017 (as a number from 1 to 12) were the most orders delivered to customers, and how many?

sql.query:
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_delivered_customer_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND DATE_PART('year', order_delivered_customer_date) = 2017
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY delivered_orders DESC, month ASC
LIMIT 1;

questions.answer: Month 12 (December) had the most delivered orders in 2017, with 7,205 deliveries.

questions.question: How many orders were approved in January 2018?

sql.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS approved_orders_jan2018
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'approved'
  AND order_approved_at >= '2018-01-01'::timestamp
  AND order_approved_at < '2018-02-01'::timestamp;

questions.answer: 0 orders were approved in January 2018. Reading: counted orders with order_status = 'approved' and order_approved_at between 2018-01-01 and 2018-01-31 (inclusive).

questions.question: How many orders were there in the first quarter of 2018?

sql.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_q1_2018 FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01 00:00:00' AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-04-01 00:00:00';

questions.answer: There were 21,208 orders in Q1 2018 (from Jan 1 to Mar 31, 2018).

questions.question: How many items from the 'informatica_acessorios' category were sold?

sql.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS sold_items
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name = 'informatica_acessorios'
  AND o.order_status = 'delivered';

questions.answer: I count 7,644 items sold from the 'informatica_acessorios' category (assuming "sold" means items in delivered orders).

questions.question: What was the total sales revenue in 2017, counting item prices only (without freight)?

sql.query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.price), 0) AS total_revenue_2017
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01 00:00:00';

questions.answer: The total sales revenue in 2017 (calendar year, counting item prices only and excluding freight) is 6,155,806.98.

questions.question: Which seller has sold the most items? Give the seller_id and the number of items sold.

sql.query:
SELECT oi.seller_id, COUNT(*) AS items_sold
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY oi.seller_id
ORDER BY items_sold DESC
LIMIT 1;

questions.answer:
Reading: considering only delivered orders as completed sales.

Top seller: seller_id 6560211a19b47992c3666cc44a7e94c0 with 1996 items sold.

questions.question: Which product category had the highest sales revenue (sum of item prices)? Give the category and the revenue.

sql.query:
SELECT p.product_category_name, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

questions.answer:
Reading: I treated category as the product's category name (product_category_name in products) and summed order_items.price for all items, grouped by category.

Answer: Beleza_saude had the highest sales revenue, 1,258,681.34.

questions.question: What is the average number of installments for credit card payments? Round to two decimals.

sql.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payment_installments), 2) AS avg_installments FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card';

questions.answer: The average number of installments for credit card payments is 3.51 installments (rounded to two decimals).

questions.answer: Using the interpretation that a product has no category when product_category_name is NULL or an empty string, there are 610 products with no category.
